title: Liu Nyoh Zung

POLICE FORCE.

14th February 1918

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 41
Date 14-2-18

Sir,
Liu Nyoh Zung 劉玉成 who assassinated the manager of the Bank of China, was shot at the Arsenal yesterday afternoon.
Sung Tse Tsung 沈再春 chauffeur to the late Admiral Tseng was sentenced to two years imprisonment three days ago at the Arsenal for failing to attempt to save his master's life by putting on speed when the latter's motor car was attacked by assassins at the Garden Bridge.
Another code telegram has been received at the Arsenal instructing the Authorities there to hurry up with the manufacture of munitions and telling them that the more they can make the better.
Since the withdrawal of the warships from Shanghai, Sung Pao Nyi 沈保義 Chief of the Water Police, has been in charge of the patrolling of the Whangpoo. Sung made an inspection yesterday of the new area which has come under his control.
It is reported that rebel agents who reside in the western part of Frenchtown are trying to purchase arms in Shanghai.
On the last day of the Chinese New year a distribution of rice and money was made to the famine sufferers of the Nanwei and Chihso districts and since that date the marching to and fro in that region of bands of men, women, and children in search of food has entirely ceased.

Your Obedient Servant,
Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

1918年2月14日

刑事侦缉处。
情报官登记
第41号
日期 18-2-14

先生：
刺杀中国银行经理的刘玉成（Liu Nyoh Zung），于昨日下午在兵工厂被枪决。
已故海军上将曾（Tseng）的司机沈再春（Sung Tse Tsung），因在前任主人乘坐的汽车于外白渡桥遭刺客袭击时未加速行驶以试图挽救主人性命，于三天前在兵工厂被判处两年监禁。
兵工厂方面又收到一封密电，指示当局加快军火制造进度，并告知产量越高越好。
自军舰撤离上海以来，水上警察局局长沈保义（Sung Pao Nyi）一直负责黄浦江的巡逻工作。沈昨日视察了新划归其管辖的区域。
据报，居住在法租界西部的反叛分子代理人正试图在上海购买武器。
在中国农历新年的最后一天，南汇和川沙地区的饥民获得了大米和现金的发放，自那以后，该地区成群结队的男女老少四处奔波寻找食物的现象已完全停止。

您顺从的仆人，
阿姆斯特朗（Armstrong）
首席侦探督察。

警务处警司上尉。
